title: Design System: Wax In The City SL

display.purpose: Hero and major brand statements only.

body.purpose: Clear service, branch, and booking copy.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift for service and form surfaces.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Meaningful hover lift on repeated cards.

motion.name: micro-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover lift and action feedback.

components.name: Primary Booking Button
components.description: Wine conversion button for booking paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{height:56px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;padding:16px 32px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a20f37,#6f1726);color:#fff7f9;font:600 18px/1.2 Avenir Next,Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(151,35,58,.34);transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(151,35,58,.42)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgba(162,15,55,.55);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Pearl Field
components.css: .ds-field{height:48px;width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(234,215,223,.85);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);padding:12px 16px;color:#1f171a;font:400 16px/1.5 Avenir Next,Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.76),0 10px 28px rgba(39,19,21,.05);transition:border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,background-color .3s ease}.ds-field::placeholder{color:#65565d}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:0;border-color:rgba(162,15,55,.7);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(162,15,55,.12)}

components.name: Premium Service Card
components.description: Repeated treatment card with a tailored edge.
components.html:
Brazilian Wax

Private, careful and appointment-led.
components.css: .ds-card{border:1px solid rgba(84,56,51,.12);border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.94),rgba(255,247,249,.74));padding:24px;color:#1f171a;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(42,20,22,.08);transition:transform .52s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .52s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(44,21,25,.14)}.ds-card-rule{display:block;width:48px;height:1px;background:#a20f37;margin-bottom:20px}.ds-card h3{margin:0;font:600 18px/1.4 Avenir Next,Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card p{margin:12px 0 0;color:#65565d;font:400 14px/1.6 Avenir Next,Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif}

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Transparent over hero, pearl pill after scroll.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(234,215,223,.7);border-radius:9999px;background:rgba(255,247,249,.88);padding:6px;box-shadow:0 4px 32px rgba(28,15,15,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}.ds-nav a{border-radius:9999px;padding:8px 16px;color:#1f171a;text-decoration:none;font:600 14px/1 Avenir Next,Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a:focus-visible{background:#fce5ec;color:#a20f37;outline:0}

narrative.overview: The system should feel like stepping behind a velvet curtain into a private appointment room: dark wine, pearled blush, precise gold, and confident type.
keyCharacteristics: Dark wine brand fields with pearled blush relief.
Fashion-label display type paired with clean appointment-system body type.
Tight, quiet components with 8px cards and pill CTAs only where the action deserves it.
Motion that feels like a composed reveal, not a hover toy.

rules.name: The Jewelry Rule
rules.body: Gold is an accent, not a theme. If a section uses more than one gold element, one must become wine or plum.

rules.name: The No Candy Pink Rule
rules.body: Pink may be pearl or blush, never bubblegum, neon, or cosmetic-template pink.

rules.name: The Blur Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is allowed only when it separates interface from photography or dark hero content. Decorative blur on ordinary cards is prohibited.

dos: Do make the first viewport say privacy, hygiene, and appointment-led care before it says beauty.
Do use oxblood and pearl as the main brand contrast, with gold as a controlled detail.
Do keep card corners at 8px and use pill shapes only for actions, chips, and nav containers.
Do respect reduced motion and keep motion available as enhancement, not a requirement to read content.
donts: Don't use generic pink salon templates.
Don't use overdone glass and cursor effects.
Don't rely on stock-photo sameness when client photography becomes available.
Don't hide booking reliability problems behind success messages.
